title: premna rubens
intro: Premna rubens, commonly known as the Himalayan mocksteer or the 'Kanakchur' in some parts of India, is a medicinal plant species belonging to the family Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include the reduction of fever, relief from cough and cold, and its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Premna rubens are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve flatulence, and act as a diuretic. Its bioactive constituents include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
